summary: Verified Services marketplace subcategory filtering & validation on both backend and frontend. All 7 pytest backend tests pass; full Playwright frontend flow validates chip row, URL persistence, toggle behavior, hide-on-non-matching-category, and clear-category reset.
verified_behaviors: GET ?category=home-services-repair&subcategory=plumbing returns exactly the tagged gig 85ae999e-1086-4e91-89c4-c89532792f49
Frontend: subcategory row hidden by default; appears with 5 chips after clicking Home Services & Repair
Frontend: clicking services-sub-plumbing adds ?subcategory=plumbing to URL and count drops to (1)
Frontend: aria-pressed toggles true→false and URL loses subcategory on second click
Frontend: switching to Personal Care hides the subcategory row
Frontend: services-category-clear ('Show all') resets both category and subcategory query params
critical_code_review_comments: _validate_subcategory correctly permits both known subcategory slugs and long-tail slug-shape strings (max 40 chars, alnum + -_ space) — safe against HTML injection.
LIST endpoint applies subcategory only inside category branch (correct behavior; global ?subcategory ignored).

PATCH /gigs does not call _validate_subcategory when subcategory field is updated — minor: a malicious subcategory could be set via patch. Consider re-validating (low-priority since patch is auth-gated to gig owner).
